termination: The JSC may allocate and/or re-allocate funds to studies as necessary and agreed by JSC.

The Parties shall promptly replace that study with a new study similar in scope if it is terminated early or does not initiate; once agreed by the JSC, such replacement study will be funded by the Alliance Funding and payable according to agreed milestones for such replacement study.

MD Anderson shall obtain, prepare, store and ship all Study patient samples required for any Clinical Study in accordance with applicable laws, Consent, Authorization, IRB guidelines, study reference manuals, and reasonable written instructions provided by Adaptimmune. Both Parties shall retain such samples as permitted under the same conditions.

MD Anderson shall maintain complete accurate records with respect to any Study as set forth in any Protocol or Study Order. All such study records must be retained by MD Anderson for the time period required by Applicable Law, providing thirty days' prior written notice of disposal intentions to allow Adaptimmune the opportunity to request continuation at its own expense.

MD Anderson agrees that any termination of Study Orders shall allow for: (i) wind down of the study ensuring safety of Study subjects; and (ii) Adaptimmune's final reconciliation of data related to the Study in addition to its final monitoring visit. All reasonable fees associated with such activities will be paid by Adaptimmune, to the extent not covered by Alliance Funding.
A Party may also terminate any Study Order in certain circumstances, including:
(c) where IRB requests termination of any Study.

Termination of one or more Study Orders will not automatically result in the termination of this Agreement or any other Study Order.
Upon termination of a Study Order, MD Anderson will immediately return (at Adaptimmune's cost) any Study Drugs provided by Adaptimmune for such Study as directed by Adaptimmune.

Termination or cancellation of this Agreement or a Study Order will not affect the rights and obligations that have accrued prior to termination, and any provisions of Sections 2-13 as applicable will survive expiration or termination of this Agreement and/or such particular Study Order.
In the event the Parties cannot reach agreement on a new Principal Investigator pursuant to Section 14.1, either Party may terminate such Study Order upon notice to the other Party.

Adaptimmune shall make all payments due for Study performance reasonably incurred or obligated which have accrued up to the date of termination of a Study Order or this Agreement, or upon such termination pursuant to Section 8.4.
rights_control: The main task of the JSC will be to oversee the Alliance. In order to achieve the objectives of the Alliance, the JSC will oversee each Study under the Alliance. The JSC will provide technical, scientific, clinical, and regulatory guidance to the Studies and will be responsible for monitoring their progress.

In addition, the JSC will be responsible for coordinating resolution of problems arising in the Studies or in the Alliance as a whole. In the event of any matter that the JSC cannot resolve, or in the event of any dispute regarding matters subject to JSC responsibility and save where Adaptimmune has the deciding vote in accordance with Section 1.6 above, such matter or dispute will be escalated to executive management of MD Anderson and Adaptimmune for good faith resolution.
Each Clinical Study shall be subject to review and approval by the Institutional Review Board (IRB) required by MD Anderson, prior to commencement.
These Protocols/workscope shall be considered final after being agreed to by MD Anderson and Adaptimmune, for Clinical Studies including approval by MD Anderson’s IRB.

MD Anderson shall ensure that each Principal Investigator conduct a Study in accordance with the terms of this Agreement, relevant Study Order, applicable Protocol or workscope provisions, GCP requirements as incorporated by FDA regulations, ethical principles of the Declaration of Helsinki and any other applicable orders/mandates.

MD Anderson represents that it has not been debarred by FDA pursuant to its authority under Sections 306(a) and (b) of the U.S. Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act and is not subject to any investigation or proceeding which may result in such a bar.

MD Anderson agrees to promptly notify Adaptimmune if it becomes aware of its debarment, exclusion from lists maintained by FDA's Office of Inspector General, inclusion on said Lists, and/or subject to any investigation or proceeding that may result in such actions.

MD Anderson and Adaptimmune shall comply with all applicable federal, state, and local laws pertaining to confidentiality, consent and disclosure of information obtained during the Study. Access is permitted only as authorized by a relevant study subject, IRB or law.

Prior to participation in any Clinical Study, MD Anderson will ensure that it has obtained signed written informed consent from each Subject (Consent) and HIPAA authorization document adequately disclosing the circumstances under which personal data might be disclosed. Adaptimmune agrees with contents of Consent or Authorization provided to any study patient prior to use in a Clinical Study.

Adaptimmune, Adaptimmune Limited and its Joint Research Partners will only obtain access to individually identifiable health information as permitted by the IRB, consent document, authorization for such disclosure under HIPAA regulations (45 C.F.R.), this Agreement, and applicable laws.

MD Anderson shall not subcontract its or the Principal Investigator’s responsibilities under this Agreement without Adaptimmune's prior written consent. Any such consent provided does not enable the relevant sub-contractor to further subcontract its responsibilities to any other third party.

MD Anderson shall ensure that any subcontracting is governed by a binding agreement which imposes on the subcontractor obligations and responsibilities substantially equivalent to those set out in this Agreement, to the extent applicable. Regardless of delegation of duties to any subcontractor, MD Anderson remains obligated to fulfill all its obligations under this Agreement.

MD Anderson shall provide all necessary personnel, facilities and resources required for their responsibilities hereunder and as specified in the Study Order; Adaptimmune agrees that: (a) it will not use Proprietary Materials except to exercise rights or perform obligations under this Agreement. It will comply with applicable laws when using such materials, (b) it will not transfer any of them without MD Anderson's prior written consent.

The obligations listed in this Section 5 will not apply to information: (a) which is in the public domain at the time of disclosure, (b) that was rightfully in possession of receiving Party at the time of such disclosure by disclosing party; (c) independently developed by receiving Party without use of disclosing Party’s Confidential Information; or (d) received legally from any third party and not subject to an obligation of confidentiality.

The receipt of information required for obtaining informed consent from patients or subjects will be communicated only as necessary, provided it is requested by the patient/subject themselves. The disclosure shall occur in a manner that does not violate any Applicable Laws and regulations; (e) may also disclose Confidential Information of any other Party where required to do so pursuant to applicable Law.

MD Anderson will keep Adaptimmune reasonably informed about progress and respond promptly to any reasonable queries. Oral reports or interim status updates on pre-clinical studies will be provided by Principal Investigator, at least once every months during the study period.

The Principal Investigator will provide interim written status reports of the progress of the Studies to Adaptimmune on a regular basis and at least once every three months during the course of this Study.

In the context of any Clinical Study, MD Anderson shall timely prepare and submit case report forms as soon as reasonably possible but in no event later than five business days following completion of any patient visit; and responses to data resolution queries are also required within three business days after receipt thereof.

MD Anderson will permit inspections by responsible legal and regulatory authorities with respect to such Clinical Study, provided that MD Anderson notifies Adaptimmune in advance if reasonably possible. Any findings resulting from any such inspection must be promptly communicated to Adaptimmune for correction or comment.

In relation to any Clinical Study, Adaptimmune shall have the right to publish or publicly disclose data arising from such study. Such rights do not include publication of MD Anderson Records or protected health information by HIPAA nor publications that would be in breach of consent and/or authorization.

Except as expressly set forth in this Agreement, to the extent required by law or regulation, or necessary for MD Anderson or Adaptimmune for the recruitment of subjects to any Study hereunder, neither Party will make public presentations about any Study conducted under this Agreement without prior written consent.

If a designated Principal Investigator is terminated from a Study or if there's death or non-availability of such investigator, MD Anderson shall use reasonable efforts to designate a duly qualified person. If the new principal cannot agree to terms and conditions, either party may terminate the respective study order in accordance with Section 8.5.

This Agreement and/or any study order may not be assigned by either Party except upon written agreement, which assignment rights will inure to the benefit of their permitted successors and assigns. Any attempt at unauthorized assignment or delegation is void unless otherwise agreed in writing.

MD Anderson and Adaptimmune shall each act as independent parties; nothing contained herein creates an agency or partnership between them, except where expressly authorized by this Agreement or a Study Order. Neither Party has authority to agree on behalf of the other beyond such authorization.

In the event that performance of the obligations of a Party hereunder are prevented by events beyond their reasonable control, including acts of God, regulations or acts of any governmental authority, war, civil commotion, strikes, or other labor disturbances (Force Majeure), the affected Party will promptly notify the other Party of such event using the procedure defined herein and the Parties shall be relieved of their respective obligations to the extent that performance is actually prevented thereby. During the existence of any such condition, the affected Party shall, nevertheless, use its best efforts to remove the cause thereof and resume performance of its obligations under this Agreement.

liability_legal: Neither MD Anderson nor Principal Investigator shall amend any Protocol except as necessary to eliminate immediate hazard to safety, rights or welfare of a patient unless required by IRB. Any deviation from the Protocol must be agreed upon in advance if possible and otherwise approved by IRB.
